description:
Accept or decline a contact request or group invitation from inbox. Ask your
user first.

Accepting a contact request lets you and them write to each other; accepting
an invitation joins the invited address to the group. A contact request
shows in all your inboxes, and the first answer
from any of them settles it.

accept.description: true to accept; false to decline and delete it

from_agent.description: One of your own agents to write as, so answers reach it; it must have read its inbox once. Leave it out to write as yourself.

request_id.description: The request's id, from inbox's requests

name: answer
title: Answer
